newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LEDESMA SENT OFF IN ARGENTINA VICTORY.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LEDESMA SENT OFF IN ARGENTINA VICTORY.

text.p: Argentine replacement Mario Ledesma was sent off after a rumpus at the end of the touring side's 25-17 victory over the South West on Sunday.
Referee Ashley Rowden gave Ledesma his marching orders as tempers flared.
The Pumas owed their success to a concerted forward effort in which prop Martin Scelzo and lock Jose Simes stood out in a game played in heavy rain.
Skipper and number eight Pablo Camerlinck urged his forwards on by superb example and only some stout defence prevented Argentina from winning by a bigger margin.
Had the weather been kinder, the talented Pumas backs, especially winger Diego Albanese and outside half Jose Scilley, might well have extended the South West more.
The South West made the perfect start when their forwards drove deep into Pumas territory and seemingly the whole pack went over the touring side's line for flanker Nick Southern to touch down.
The Argentines replied swiftly, centre Eduardo Simone getting a try by the posts which Jose Cilley converted.
Despite the slippery conditions the Pumas were determined to run the ball and were rewarded when a flowing move produced a try for Albanese.
A penalty goal by Cilley gave the touring team a 15-5 halftime lead.
Argentine exerted heavy forward pressure at the start of the second half and wing Tomas Solari and hooker Carlos Promanzio added tries.
The South West responded briefly and got a well deserved penalty try when the Pumas were penalised for persistent killing of the ball. Green converted.
